General rules? First, just read for a while. Don't post immediately unless you have a thick skin.

Second, don't post photos you've taken personally (unless you understand metadata well). Also, it takes about a minute to dox someone based on pictures from social networking. This means don't copy your crush's profile picture and ask people to rate them (happens all the time).

Third, just don't post info about you or people you know. No names, birth months, past jobs, financial info, medical conditions, cars you drive, time zones, ect. No ammount of proxies will help you stay private if someone reads unsecured info that leads to your name.

Fourth, don't click links. Just dont. Best case is you get a jump-scare page. Worst case you end up with malware or looking at illegal content.

More than anything else, don't be an idiot, and don't piss people off. People don't get doxxed randomly. There is virtually always a financial, political, or moral reason when such things happen.
